label: Bible Study
prompt: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without _____ of the church unto God for him.
verse: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
note: Peter in Herod's prison, the church on its knees — an angel showed up that night.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He maketh me to lie down in green _____: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verse: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
note: Green pastures and still waters — the Shepherd picks the spot where the sheep can finally lie down.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Meekness, _____: against such there is no law.
verse: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
note: The fruit of the Spirit ends with meekness and temperance — self-control — and there's no law against any of it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a _____ in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verse: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
note: Paul never names his thorn — he asked three times for it to go and got 'My grace is sufficient' instead.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And David _____ all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
verse: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
note: At Ziklag David lost everything; after he 'encouraged himself in the LORD' (30:6), he 'recovered all.'
